lead: Rabri Devi is best known as an Indian politician, born on 1 January 1959 in Gopalganj.
As of 2026, she is 67 years old, and her birth date places her under the Capricorn sign.
She has held the office of Chief Minister of Bihar and Member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly.
The sections that follow break down Rabri Devi's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Rabri Devi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Rabri Devi works primarily as a politician.

She has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Bihar (2000–2005), Member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly, Chief Minister of Bihar (1999–2000) and Chief Minister of Bihar (1997–1999). She is affiliated with Rashtriya Janata Dal.
